record_scope_definition: Complete original assembly ranges are hashed as evidence boundaries. These seven records are not seven fully rebuilt original function bodies, and do not measure whole-game completion.
source_reconstruction_scope: Bounded original Crypt GhostAmbush01 Wait/Spawn session, owned native PyData tables, synchronous existing-Character factory dispatch, source Wait quantization and caller frame-phase ordering.
caller_facts: The original common table has 15 scripts and the Crypt table has 25. GhostAmbush01 local index 2/global ID 17 is Wait250, Spawn _prim_Monster_SURPRISE_01, Wait75, Spawn _prim_Monster_SURPRISE_02.

The direct pair and its ordinary one-shot zero-delay TriggerZone belong to crypt_straight_c_ns_01.mgp. GhostAmbushHallway and four weighted _prim_tmp_ambusher actors belong to a separate module/script path.

ExecuteScript checks a waiting command before adding current dt, then returns after Update without another check. A newly executed positive Wait is reset then updated with this same pass dt. Prior wait overshoot is discarded.

Level::Update calls ExecuteAllScripts at ELF0x3f8994, branches back to0x3f8474, then calls PhysicalWorld::update at0x3f84c8 and ObjectManager::Update at0x3f84e8. Trigger contact during ObjectManager becomes runnable next level update.
Script tables own their immutable decoded storage. Candidate session load is atomic and stable heap ownership retains task/script pointers and callback context until session disposal.

SpawnServices runs synchronously before scheduler shadow mutation and command PC advancement. Missing existing Characters are no-op misses, bound-service failure is terminal, and unsupported selected-program services are rejected before activation.

Activity/context restore retains session elapsed waits, activation count and trigger edge state while native bodies and renderer resources are rebound. Internal Prince scene load must preserve session ownership; public preview and failed world load dispose the session.
unsupported: Arbitrary ScriptManager commands, skip/cutscene policy, full task/level save serialization, online/multi-player producers and full original manager body reconstruction are outside this adapter.
Generic diagnostic scheduler unsupported-command no-ops are not allowed for the selected live Crypt program; SpawnSession accepts only Wait and SpawnCharacter.

Original ObjectManager lookup filters by module ID (unless global/special-player policy applies). Current uniquely named pair is bounded; repeated-module expansion requires that producer and ownership model, not a global-name assumption.
Native integration source presence and host tests do not themselves prove Android runtime/rendered gameplay success. Device evidence must be reported separately with the tested APK identity.
Fresh Ghost Spawn/Idle/body services are bounded. Autonomous combat/AI, broad revival, weighted Hallway actors and full campaign reconstruction remain separate work.
Original Wait uses signed int elapsed addition. The bounded scheduler uses saturated uint32 elapsed arithmetic for exposed extreme dt; ordinary application frame dt is the reconstructed path.

verification.method: all seven complete indexed assembly ranges reconstructed and SHA256 checked; Script_Wait virtual slots independently resolved by original vtable
